designationHistory.name: Black Coulee Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Black Coulee Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7801; it is now Black Coulee National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Black Coulee National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7801—Establishing Black Coulee Migratory Waterfowl Refuge, Montana (Jan 28, 1938)

review.note: EO 7801, 1938-01-28 (Franklin D. Roosevelt). Draft signer field held "Executive Order Number"; President is FDR.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Black Coulee National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1938 by Executive Order Number 7801 as “a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.
